fusions.name: Barb Left Behind
fusions.desc: A stab that deals 7 poison damage, leaves the target 6% easier to wound for 4 seconds and [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 6 seconds. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Stirred Hive
fusions.desc: Stabs at everything in reach, dealing 10 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles. Your afflictions on each one spread to every enemy within 4 tiles of it.

fusions.name: Worker's Tempo
fusions.desc: Increases your attack speed by 25% for 10 seconds. A swarm escorts you for 8 seconds, stinging for 3 damage every 1.4 seconds.

fusions.name: Tireless Round
fusions.desc: When one of your afflictions runs out on an enemy, 6 stamina comes back to you. Once every 5 seconds.
